note.goal: Read the keeper's note on the table

clues.name: The Keeper's Note
lore: You were breathing when they brought you in. That is enough.
Bread by the hearth. Tools and boots below the iron hatch.
Take what you need. Leave a light for the next one.
clues.journal: Someone carried me to a Hearthkeeper's shelter. The keeper left bread above and tools below.

clues.name: The Store's Packing Slip
lore: Three stone tools. Boots. Twelve torches. Coal and potatoes.
Keep the door shut after dark. There is no keeper here tonight.
Wait for daylight if you can. A town will take you in.
clues.journal: The cellar is stocked for a traveller, not a soldier. I can keep the shelter tonight or take my chances outside.

watch.goal: Keep watch by the hearth after dark

lines.say: Beyond the porch light, a wolf calls. Another answers farther off.
Something scrapes the outside of the door, then stops.
Footsteps cross the porch. They move away into the dark.
The wood settles. Nothing else comes to the door.

watch.journal: I kept watch in the shelter. Something tried the door and went away.

dawn.goal: Rest in the shelter until daylight
dawn.journal: Daylight reached the windows. It was time to find other people.

road.journal: I reached {place:town}, carrying what the keeper left for a stranger.

arrived.text: I woke in a Hearthkeeper's shelter and found my way to town. I never learned who carried me in.
